description: Ministry of Higher Education and Cultural Affairs - Notify the Degree Awarding Institute Order of SLT Campus
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns a legal/regulatory matter - an Order issued under Section 25A of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It amends the schedule to a previous order regarding degree programs offered by SLT Campus (Pvt) Ltd, which constitutes subsidiary legislation. While it mentions a Minister's name, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers to make regulatory changes, not about government personnel changes or portfolio assignments. The core content is about legal/regulatory framework for higher education institutions.
